title: Russia diesel policy-state reconciliation
accepted_findings: MACRO: Russia diesel restriction risk horizon is no longer safely modeled as a mechanical end-October expiry.
AION: sanctions relief is not the sole stated condition for resumed exports; domestic overproduction is a competing relief condition and must remain a separate timestamped state.
rejected_findings: Reject a single-condition sanctions-linked structural export-withdrawal regime.
Reject policy statements as proof of realized October-November export volumes, global shortage magnitude, directional alpha, or trading authority.
Reject fresh local-GGUF shadow execution as current restored-five health evidence when its inspected inputs are October 1 slots.
conflicts: Oct 1 presidential sanctions-linked withdrawal language conflicts with/was qualified by Oct 2 deputy-PM overproduction relief language.
Political intent, formal rule, exemptions, refinery output, realized customs/shipping flows, inventories, and cracks remain distinct authority layers.
blockers: Actual October-November Russian diesel export/customs/shipping volumes remain unverified.
Implementation hierarchy among rhetoric, formal rules, exemptions, and overproduction relief remains unresolved.
No frozen event population, effective-N estimate, multiplicity correction, protected OOS block, or cost-valid trading rule.
next_highest_value_integration_target: JANUS/ATHENA should encode a timestamped policy-to-flow transition chain: RHETORIC -> FORMAL_RULE -> RELIEF_OR_EXEMPTION -> REFINERY_OUTPUT -> REALIZED_EXPORT_FLOW -> INVENTORY_AND_CRACK_RESPONSE, preserving contradictory/qualifying states instead of overwriting them. Promotion beyond policy-risk requires verified physical flows.

athena.finding: Treat Russian diesel policy as branching uncertainty: sanctions-linked withdrawal and domestic-overproduction relief are competing timestamped conditions; physical-flow confirmation is still required.

janus.finding: Preserve Oct 1 and Oct 2 policy observations as separate immutable project-twin states and reconcile them through a multi-condition policy-to-flow transition model rather than a single structural-regime label.

infrastructure.finding: The newest local-GGUF shadow run executed at 05:45Z but inspected October 1 restored-five slots, so it cannot promote current worker-health state; GitHub-native v3 remains the authoritative liveness/persistence plane.

helios_prime.finding: Integrate Macro and AION at the causal-state layer only; do not transfer policy-statement authority into realized flow, performance, or execution authority.
